observed_thread.observed_text:
NFP preview: why a payroll beat needs help from unemployment


https://
capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/nfp-preview-
why-a-payroll-beat-needs
…

Source: BLS.

A payroll beat alone cannot settle the October jobs story.

Watch unemployment, revisions and wages, then ask whether rates and the dollar agree.

Watch: Indices: Better employment could improve revenue expectations even as higher yields weigh on valuations.

A weak report could ease discount-rate pressure while raising earnings concerns.

Growth and interest rates can therefore point equities in opposite directions.

Analysis, not financial advice.
